title: ר' אבין בר הונא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.

paragraphs: Rabbi Avin bar Huna said in R. Chama bar Gurya’s name, Shabbat 66b. “Avin bar Huna said in R. Chama bar Gurya’s name” occurs six times. There, 139b: Rabbi Avin bar Rav Huna said in R. Chama bar Gurya’s name. The words “Rabbi” and “Rav” are certainly scribal errors. Zevachim 62b: Abaye bar Huna said in R. Chama bar Gurya’s name—also an error; it should read Avin. True words are recognizable.
